company_info.company_description: " We are committed to raising the bar in the solar industry.At Ultimate Solar Energy, we strive in the realm of providing affordable and high quality solar installation services in Australia. We aim to achieve a fossil free future by helping our customers switch to solar energy.ExpertiseOur in-house team consists of SAA accredited skilled solar designers and installers who follow the changes in latest technology trends and innovate to provide solutions to complex problems.Quality Assurance Commitment.Our top priority is to give our valued clients premium quality products with advanced cutting-edge technology approved by the Clean Energy Council (CEC) Australia.Excellence In Customer CareWe recognize our responsibility to educate you about the product and provide you guidance with an end-to-end process outline  that makes it decision-making easier.WarrantyUltimate Solar Energy provides backing for every system installed with a full 5 year “Whole of System” warranty; and on-site servicing and rectification for a period of 5 years in addition to product warranties. This shows our commitment and adherence towards sustainable policies and Australian standards.Budget-FriendlyWe guide you towards rebates and incentives (STCs & LGCs) to develop affordable packages for you that highlight affordability."

reviews.review_description: A very sleek-looking battery! We wanted to become energy independent and use clean energy for our pool heat pump, heating and cooling systems, and full-house backup.Ultimate Solar Energy handled the entire project with great care and professionalism. They’ve completed several installations for us across our commercial sites, and as an organisation involved in social service and charity work, we truly appreciate their supportive and understanding approach.Highly recommend them to friends and family!

I received a very competitive quote on a 19.2 KW GoodWe battery and hybrid inverter from Ultimate Solar Energy,The installers arrived on time, installed the battery and cleaned up with a minimum of fuss,the professionalism of the team at USE and workmanship of the installers was fantastic.I fully appreciate the effort by the team at Ultimate Solar Energy from quote to installation.and would highly recommend them to anyone who is interested in adding a battery or installing a solar system in general.

I recently had a full solar, battery, hot water system, & Split system aircon installed by Ultimate Solar, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the very beginning, Eric — my sales consultant — was exceptional. Over the course of three months, he maintained constant communication, patiently answered every single question I had, and took calls at all hours without hesitation. He returned calls promptly without needing follow-ups and was hands-down the most pleasant and professional sales person I’ve dealt with.The installation process was smooth and well-organized. Everything was delivered and installed on time, just as promised. The solar and battery setup was outstanding — the installers were efficient, respectful, and left the site clean and tidy. The hot water installation was decent, though not quite at the same level. I did run into some issues with the air conditioning installers, but that was outside Ultimate Solar’s scope. That said, I’d recommend they consider working with more capable aircon partners in future.Overall, I got a fantastic deal from Eric, and the system is running perfectly. No issues so far, and with a 5-year workmanship warranty across the board, I feel confident and well-covered. Big thanks to Eric and the Ultimate Solar team for making the process seamless and stress-free.

We got a great system at a great price.  The installers did a great job with the installation. We got a reasonably large system at 32kW.  The battery system works well and since installation we have not used a single kW from the grid.  The associated software provides fantastic options for customising how we use the batteries, including protections against blackouts.  We are looking forward to not paying any more electrical bills.

They also explained the system’s features in detail, including how to monitor energy usage and storage through the Tesla app, which I’ve found very easy to use.What impressed me most about Ultimate Solar Energy was their customer service. It’s rare to see this level of care and professionalism.I highly recommend Ultimate Solar Energy to anyone considering solar solutions or battery storage. If you’re looking for a trustworthy company that delivers both top-quality products and outstanding service, they are the ones to go with.

Mid August I sought quotes for a solar system. Having a single story terracotta roof narrowed down the list somewhat. Some installers declined. Ultimate Solar Energy quoted the best price on 15 x Jinko Tiger 440 w panels and a Fronius Primo Gen4 inverter. This was some $4500 better than the most expensive quote. The difference in specification being the guarantee on the installation only. Ultimate relying on a 5 year ( industry min. standard ) versus a 15 year warranty on rails and 10 years on installation and components for the expensive quote. The extra guarantee cost seems excessive. Time will tell.The panels were installed on November 10. The fine print does say be patient. The installers are very busy all over Melbourne and its a matter of fitting you in. Be prepared for a next day installation offer! Installation of the panels  took 6 hours on a hot day. Three tiles (only) broke and replaced. Very happy with the care they took on the roof. Checked underneath and no leaks after the rain recently.Inverter was installed November 20 and connected to meter December 1. Noticed the power output immediately on Powerpal app. December 4 the Fronius inverter app finally installed and working on my smartphone. This required a lot of communication regarding wi-fi, passwords etc with Ultimate to function. Full information regarding power output on the app was not available until a few days later. ( this is a Fronius issue not Ultimate's ). Be patient.It is 22 December and the system has produced an average of 28kwh per day over 21days vs the expected 33.3 kwh for 31 days of Dec. Given the rainy / cloudy weather so far this month, performance is on specification. As yet I am still waiting for Powercorp to follow through with my power supplier. So wait.I have a 300litre heat pump for hot water. Most days the solar panels power this and more. My power bill has dropped at least by one third.To sum up: An installer prepared to do a tile roof was a big concern. Ultimate Solar Energy had the best of quote and did an excellent installation. Be prepared to wait. The process is convoluted and would have been less frustrating if a step by step guide was available. They are easy to communicate with so long as you take the initiative and reach out.

I choose Ultimate Solar as their quote included for quality products yet their price was lower than other quotes with less desirable products.The Good:- The price- The brand name panels and inverter- Overall I am satisfied with the performance I am getting from the install- The installation team made sure they understood what I wanted was what they were installing and did a good job.- The did help to organize grid connection after the installThe Bad:- I began the process with Ultimate Solar in October. The sales person assured me multiple times that my system would be installed prior to the end of 2022. I was jerked around by the sales person for weeks and eventually called their 1300 number to speak to someone else. My system wasn't installed until mid February.- I have a mostly flat roof. I told them that I did not want the panels installed on my 10 degree roof. I was told that the pitch would not have an effect on the systems production. I asked them what the ideal angle for the panel is in Melbourne and he couldn't answer my question. I found it concerning that I had to educate him on this aspect of solar installation.- Post installation and getting the systems power app set up on my phone has been a struggle for 4 weeks now. The owners manual is woefully compiled and the poor images and lack of instruction make it useless. I have had to correspond directly with their customer service directly to get this sorted.Overall:- It has been a struggle to get the system i wanted installed and application set up.- If you want a hands-off experience while also the piece of mind you are getting the best system and service this is not the company for you. That being said you will likely have to pay more for a company that includes a bit more consultation with you.- If you are happy to do the research, be a bit hands-on, and dictate to the installer what you want them Ultimate Solar will offer a competitive price
